info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Deployment Deployment-spec
info.description: The Product Deployment Management API facilitates the seamless deployment of product specifications within the banking sector. This endpoint enables businesses to initiate and manage the deployment process for various products, ensuring that configurations are accurately applied and ready for use. Typical consumers include product managers and deployment engineers who require an efficient way to deploy updates and new product versions. This API streamlines the deployment workflow, enhancing productivity and enabling faster time-to-market for new offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a new deployment for a specific product version. Ensure that all required parameters are included and that the product is properly configured before deployment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a new product deployment. It must include all necessary parameters and data structures as defined in the specified schema.
